abstract: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA) receptor encephalitis is a rare but occasionally fatal limbic encephalitis that may be accompanied by ovarian teratoma. Since the neuroglial tissue within the teratoma may be involved in the pathogenesis of this encephalitis, we attempted morphological and immunohistochemical characterization of the neuroglial tissue in four cases of ovarian teratoma associated with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and 12 control cases, i.e., six consecutive cases of immature teratoma and six cases of mature teratoma with an abundant neuronal component, focusing mainly on NMDA receptor-expressing neurons. NMDA receptor-expressing neurons, being observed in all of the cases analyzed, were significantly densely aggregated (P = 0.030, Wilcoxon test) and relatively smaller in size in the encephalitis-associated cases than in the control cases, and the Ki-67 labeling index of neuroglial cells with these neurons was significantly higher in the encephalitis-associated cases (P = 0.004, Wilcoxon test). In the cases with encephalitis, aggregation of B-cells within or around the neuroglial tissue was also observed. Our present findings may be useful for more accurate diagnosis of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and contribute to a better understanding of the pathogenesis.
abstract_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎は、まれではあるが時に致死的となりうる辺縁系脳炎であり、卵巣奇形腫を伴うことがある。奇形腫内の神経膠組織は本脳炎の病態に関与している可能性があるため、抗NMDA受容体脳炎を伴う卵巣奇形腫4例と対照12例(連続した未熟奇形腫6例、および神経細胞成分に富む成熟奇形腫6例)について、主にNMDA受容体を発現する神経細胞に着目し、神経膠組織の形態学的および免疫組織化学的特徴を解析した。NMDA受容体を発現する神経細胞は全症例で観察されたが、脳炎関連例では対照例と比較して有意に密に凝集し(P = 0.030、Wilcoxon検定)、相対的に小型であった。また、これらの神経細胞を伴う神経膠細胞のKi-67標識指数は、脳炎関連例で有意に高かった(P = 0.004、Wilcoxon検定)。脳炎を伴う症例では、神経膠組織の内部または周囲におけるB細胞の集簇も観察された。本所見は、抗NMDA受容体脳炎のより正確な診断に有用であり、病態のより良い理解に寄与しうる。
